description: The bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments," illustrates the average entropy values for three different AI models—GPT-4, Claude, and Llama—under three distinct methods: Baseline, Source Info, and Direct Command. The horizontal axis categorizes the models, while the vertical axis represents the entropy average values, ranging from 3.0 to 6.0. For each model, three bars are displayed, corresponding to the three methods, with the Baseline method shown in pink, Source Info in yellow, and Direct Command in light blue. The chart shows that for GPT-4, the Source Info method yields the highest average entropy (approximately 5.4), followed by Direct Command (around 5.1), and then Baseline (approximately 4.9). For Claude, the Source Info method again has the highest entropy (around 5.2), followed by Direct Command (approximately 5.0), and then Baseline (around 4.8). For Llama, the Source Info method has the highest entropy (around 5.0), followed by Direct Command (approximately 4.8), and then Baseline (around 4.8). The data suggests that the Source Info method generally results in higher average entropy across all three models compared to the other two methods.
